messages:
Tara: dropping a quick proposal 11 for the eval-run filters. idea: compact chips above the run table (wrap to multiple lines) instead of the persistent left rail. figma: https://figma.redwood/filters-compact :sparkles:
Diego: nice. main question: how do we handle very long tag lists? overflow? a dedicated horizontal scroller or "More" dropdown?
Ellen: accessibility concern: horizontal scrollers are awkward for keyboard and screen reader users. prefer wrap + collapse to a "Show X more" button that reveals a popover list.
Samir: performance note: rendering 200 chips could be heavy. backend should paginate counts and only fetch counts for visible filters. we can lazy-load rest on expand.
Tara: good points. proposal v1: top-of-table chips, show first 12, "+ 34 more" button opens accessible popover with search. counts shown as small badges only when >0.
Diego: UX nit: badge color should be subtle (muted background) to avoid drawing eyes away from scorecards. also ensure counts read by SR: aria-label="Approved 1 1 results".
Ellen: example aria snippet:
```
<button role="checkbox" aria-checked="false" aria-label="Flagged 1 1 1 5 results">Flagged</button>
```
Also add aria-expanded on "+ X more" and focus trap inside popover.
Samir: microcopy: use "Show more filters" for the button (clear) and helper text under filters: "Tags: match any. Filters combined with AND." avoids ambiguity.
Tara: mobile behavior: collapse into a single "Filters" chip that opens full-screen sheet with grouped controls. keep the same semantics.
Ellen: a11y QA checklist: keyboard nav between chips, screenreader announces toggles with counts, popover focus management, and verify color contrast for selected state >= 4.5:1.
Diego: implementation split: frontend adds ChipsList component with virtualized list for popover; backend provides counts endpoint. estimate 2 sprints.
Tara: action items: Diego prototype popover + virtualized list, Ellen to author a11y acceptance criteria, Samir to spec backend counts endpoint, I'll update figma and write copy. quick sync tomorrow 9am. :thumbsup:
